title: Ledup
description: A near-white page with pure white cards and one warm chocolate-brown ink, taupe labels and translucent-taupe pill buttons, a pale greige for hovers, and a warm orange for one accent card. Poppins throughout; big soft radii (20px cards, 50px panels) and almost no shadow.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with an espresso page and warm off-white ink
foreground is the brown ink and also the colour of the dark bands (values card, footer), which blocks draw with bg-foreground
primary is the taupe of the pill buttons; secondary is the pale greige of hovers and the switch bar; muted is the light grey nav pill and media placeholders
highlight and glow are the warm orange and sand of the store-count card
radius is 1.25rem (20px); page-width 85rem with 2.5rem gutters at lg (1280px content), 0.9375rem gutters on phones
name: ledup-theme
